attempts.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance on node1 to run daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The pre-existing script file was corrupted (leftover heredoc/install artifacts instead of valid shell), so it was rewritten to a clean, executable (0755 root:root) script before wiring up cron. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline, issued a self-acknowledging reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified crond active/enabled, cron entry intact, script intact, and log file retaining both pre- and post-reboot entries.
